name: HEIC Converter
description: Convert a whole Google Photos folder of iPhone HEIC stills + videos into clean WebP/JPEG/PNG/AVIF images, entirely in your browser. Videos become a still frame, Live Photo motion clips are de-duplicated, and all original metadata (incl. GPS) is stripped.

api.note: Live after tool:ready. In-memory queue; no persistence. Accepts HEIC/HEIF stills AND videos (mp4/mov/m4v), plus whole folders (folder pick or folder drop via the FileSystem Entry API). HEIC decode lazy-loads heic-to (primary) or libheif-js (fallback). Video first-frame extraction uses a native <video> element for web-friendly mp4 and falls back to FFmpeg WASM (lazy-loaded) for HEVC .mov. Every output is re-encoded from pixels so original metadata (incl. GPS) is removed. JSZip is lazy-loaded only when Download all as ZIP is invoked; the ZIP mirrors the source folder structure and is named after the dropped folder.

addFiles.description: Add HEIC/HEIF stills OR videos (mp4/mov/m4v) to the queue. Accepts either `{files}` (flat) or `{entries:[{file,relativePath}]}` (folder). Unsupported files are returned in `skipped` (reason 'not-supported'); duplicates are skipped. Re-evaluates Live Photo dedup after adding.

getItems.description: Return the current queue as a serialisable array (no Files/Blobs). Each item includes `kind` ('heic'|'video'), `relativePath`, `status` ('queued'|'running'|'done'|'error'|'skipped') and `skippedReason`.

setFormat.description: Set the output MIME: image/webp | image/jpeg | image/png | image/avif.

setQuality.description: Set the encode quality 0..1 (ignored for PNG).

setLivePhotoDedup.description: Toggle Live Photo dedup. enabled=true (default) drops the motion clip of a Live Photo pair (a video sharing a basename with a still). enabled=false also frame-extracts those clips. Standalone videos are always converted.

convertOne.description: Convert one queued item: HEIC → decode+re-encode; video → first-frame extraction (FFmpeg path for HEVC .mov surfaces load ratio via hc:item:progress). Emits hc:item:started/progress/complete/error.

convertAll.description: Re-apply Live Photo dedup, then convert every queued or errored (non-skipped) item sequentially. Emits hc:batch:started + hc:batch:complete.

downloadOne.description: Trigger a browser download of one completed item.

downloadAllZip.description: Bundle every completed item into a ZIP via JSZip and download. Mirrors the source folder structure (extension swapped to the chosen format) and names the ZIP after the dropped folder. Skipped items are excluded.

reset.description: Clear the queue, the folder name, and revoke any held object URLs.
